avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer significantly reduces everolimus plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; do not use concomitantly. Allow 2-week washout before starting everolimus.

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor increases everolimus bioavailability and toxicity risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid completely; consider alternative supplements if CYP3A4 inhibition needed.

avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer may reduce everolimus concentrations and therapeutic effect
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or use only under close clinical monitoring with possible dose adjustment.

caution_supplements.name: Milk thistle (silymarin)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Weak CYP3A4 inhibitor may modestly increase everolimus levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased adverse effects; report new symptoms to healthcare provider.

caution_supplements.name: Turmeric (curcumin)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential CYP3A4 interaction and antiplatelet effects increase bleeding risk with mTOR inhibitors
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor for bruising, bleeding, or elevated drug levels.

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition dramatically increases everolimus bioavailability and toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Absolute contraindication; eliminate from diet during everolimus therapy.

avoid_foods.name: Pomegranate juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase everolimus concentrations
avoid_foods.action: Avoid or severely restrict intake; inform clinician of any consumption.

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: Increased absorption and bioavailability of everolimus; variable exposure
caution_foods.action: Take consistently with or without food; maintain uniform dietary fat intake for stable levels.

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase hepatotoxicity risk and potentiate immunosuppression
caution_foods.action: Limit to minimal intake; discuss alcohol use with clinical team.

monitoring_notes: Monitor whole blood trough levels (target typically 3-8 ng/mL depending on indication) as everolimus has narrow therapeutic index and high inter-individual variability. Assess for signs of toxicity (mucositis, infections, pneumonitis) and counsel on strict avoidance of CYP3A4 inhibitors/inducers including herbal products.
